messages.content: Hi, checking on PRO 382-114-905. It left Mercer Falls yesterday and our receiving team needs to plan labor. When will it actually arrive?

PRO 382-114-905: on the HJX outbound and scheduled for delivery Tuesday 10:00–12:00 CT. It cross-docked at Harlow Junction overnight and is on schedule for the 2-business-day Standard LTL SLA. Your receiving team can see live status in the Brightline Track portal under that PRO.
We got billed $225 in detention fees on our last delivery and I don't think that's right. Your driver was at our dock maybe 3 hours total. Invoice INV-2026-3381, PRO 382-207-331.

PRO 382-207-331: DockSync shows check-in 08:02 and check-out 11:47 CT, so 3 h 45 min on site. The first 2 hours are free; the remaining 1 h 45 min at $75/hour comes to $131.25, not $225, so the invoice is wrong. I've sent it to billing for a credit memo of $93.75, which you'll get within 5 business days.
Our new customer in Ridley doesn't have a loading dock. Can we add a liftgate to an existing order? Shipment is 3 pallets, about 900 lb each, delivering Thursday. PRO 382-318-440

PRO 382-318-440: delivery stays Thursday 13:00–15:00 CT. I've added the LiftGate add-on ($85 for the stop); it was booked more than 24 hours before the window, so it's confirmed. At about 900 lb each, all 3 pallets are well under the 2,500 lb per handling-unit limit.
the palletpass labels keep printing tiny in the corner of the page. we're using a regular office printer. what am I doing wrong

PalletPass labels are formatted for 4×6 thermal stock, so on a letter-size office printer they come out shrunk in the corner. Print them on a 4×6 thermal label printer, one label per handling unit. Pallets that arrive without a scannable label get a $25 relabel fee per pallet at the dock.
We opened a delivery from Friday and found two cartons of glass panels crushed inside the shrink wrap. Outside of the pallet looked fine so our receiver signed clean. PRO 382-402-118. What do we do?

PRO 382-402-118: delivered Friday, so you're within the 5-calendar-day window for concealed damage. File an OS&D claim in the Track portal (Claims tab) with photos of the cartons and packaging, the BOL and the commercial invoice. The claims team will acknowledge it within 48 hours and issue a decision within 30 days.
Can we push our delivery appointment for PRO 382-455-702 from Wednesday morning to Thursday afternoon? Our dock is getting resurfaced.

PRO 382-455-702: moved to Thursday 14:00–16:00 CT in DockSync. You changed it more than 12 hours before the original window, so there's no late-change fee. You'll get the updated appointment confirmation by email.
Need to reschedule today's 1-3pm delivery, PRO 382-511-063, our forklift driver called out sick. Sorry for the short notice!!

PRO 382-511-063: moved to tomorrow 08:00–10:00 CT. Today's window was less than 12 hours away when you asked, so a $50 late-change fee applies under DockSync policy. If you'd like a different 2-hour slot tomorrow, reply with it before 20:00 CT.
Why is there a $150 charge on our invoice? It says redelivery. PRO 382-560-217

PRO 382-560-217: our first attempt was Monday 09:00–11:00 CT, and the driver found the consignee closed (photo and timestamp are in the Track portal). A missed appointment is billed as a $150 redelivery fee. If your site was actually open during that window, send us your gate log within 10 business days of the invoice date and billing will review it.
Got a reweigh adjustment on PRO 382-603-884. Our BOL said 1,840 lb. How do we know your scale is right?

PRO 382-603-884: the HJX dock scale recorded 2,010 lb, which is 9.2% over your BOL weight, so the shipment was rebilled. We only rebill when the difference is more than 5%. The reweigh certificate with the scale ticket is posted in the Track portal under this PRO.
Can you pick up 4 pallets from our Ashgrove plant today? Just finished wrapping them. It's 3:40 now.

Your pickup is booked for tomorrow 08:00–10:00 CT. Requests received after the 14:00 CT cutoff go out the next business day. Have the BOL ready and a PalletPass label on each of the 4 pallets when the driver arrives.
How much extra is it to send something Priority Lane instead of regular? We have a rush order for a customer in Kessler Bay.

Priority Lane is +$95 per shipment and delivers in 1 business day (24 h) instead of the 2-business-day Standard LTL SLA. You can add it when you book or any time until the freight is loaded at origin. Once you have a PRO number, we'll confirm the 2-hour delivery window.
We make industrial coatings and want to ship 6 drums of flammable paint (class 3) to Mercer Falls. Is that ok with you guys?

Yes. We accept Class 3 with 24 hours' notice, routed through HJX and MFT, so a Mercer Falls delivery works. Book it in the Track portal with the hazmat flag and UN number on the BOL, at least 24 hours before pickup. Hazmat can't route through Kessler Bay.
Hi there, we're a party supply company and need to move a pallet of consumer fireworks for an event next month. Can Brightline take it?
Unfortunately we can't. Brightline never accepts Class 1 explosives, and consumer fireworks fall under Class 1. Our hazmat service covers Classes 3, 8 and 9 only.
Is there a way to schedule our own delivery appointments in the portal? Right now we call in every time.

Yes. DockSync self-scheduling is included in Track Pro ($149/month), and your account is on Track Basic. Pro also includes API access, up to 10 users and a 4-hour first-response SLA. You can upgrade under Account → Plan in the Brightline Track portal, and it takes effect right away.
Our dev team wants to pull tracking status into our ERP. Do you have an API? We're on the free plan.

We do. API access comes with Track Pro ($149/month); Track Basic covers portal tracking and BOL creation only. If your ERP needs EDI 214/210 rather than the REST API, that's on Track Enterprise ($499/month).
We need EDI 214 status messages sent to our TMS for every shipment. Who do I talk to about setting that up?

EDI 214 (status) and 210 (invoice) come with Track Enterprise at $499/month, which also includes unlimited users and a named account manager, Tomas Reyes. Once you upgrade, Tomas will schedule the EDI connection test with your TMS team. Enterprise tickets get a 1-hour first response.
Hi, I'd like to pick up our freight myself at the Mercer Falls terminal instead of having it delivered. PRO 382-622-590. What are the hours?

PRO 382-622-590: converted to will-call at Mercer Falls (MFT), ready from Wednesday 07:00 CT. The will-call desk is open 07:00–17:00 CT on weekdays. Bring the PRO number and photo ID. We hold freight free for 3 business days; after that storage is $20 per pallet per day.
why are we being charged storage?? the freight was sitting at your Harlow Junction terminal, we came to get it as soon as we could. PRO 382-648-007

PRO 382-648-007: the freight was ready for will-call at HJX on Monday and picked up the following Monday, which is 5 business days. The first 3 business days are free, so 2 days of storage on 3 pallets at $20 per pallet per day comes to $120. If you think the ready date is wrong, send a billing dispute within 10 business days of the invoice date.
We ordered 6 pallets and only 5 showed up. Driver said the 6th might be at the terminal. BOL BL-448213, PRO 382-671-352. We noted it on the delivery receipt.

PRO 382-671-352: handling unit -06 scanned at HJX but missed the trailer. It's going out on Thursday 10:00–12:00 CT at no charge. You noted the shortage on the delivery receipt, so if it doesn't arrive in that window you're covered for an OS&D claim. Claims are filed in the Track portal.
Weird one — we received an extra pallet that isn't ours. Label says 382-690-114-03. What should we do with it?

PRO 382-690-114: handling unit -03 was mis-delivered to you. A driver will collect it Tuesday 13:00–15:00 CT. Please hold it near your dock and don't open it. This is logged as an OS&D overage on our side, so you won't be charged anything.
The consignee address on our BOL is wrong, it should be Dock 4, 77 Fenwick Industrial Way not Dock 2. Shipment hasn't delivered yet. PRO 382-704-226
PRO 382-704-226: consignee address changed to Dock 4, 77 Fenwick Industrial Way. Delivery stays Wednesday 08:00–10:00 CT. The corrected BOL is posted in the Track portal.
Hi, I'm just now going through last month's invoices and want to dispute a detention charge from about 5 weeks ago. PRO 382-733-519.

PRO 382-733-519: the invoice is from 5 weeks ago, and billing disputes have to be filed within 10 business days of the invoice date, so we can't reopen this charge. To make future disputes easier, DockSync check-in and check-out times for every stop are in the Track portal. Billing lead Priya Halvorsen can walk you through the dispute process if that would help.
You approved our billing dispute last week but we haven't seen a credit yet. Ref invoice INV-2026-4120.

Invoice INV-2026-4120: the dispute was approved on Thursday, and approved credit memos are issued within 5 business days, so you'll have it by end of day Thursday this week. It will show up in the Track portal under Billing and be applied to your next statement.
Are you guys open Sunday? we have a delivery issue

Customer Care is closed on Sundays. We're open Mon–Fri 06:00–20:00 CT and Sat 08:00–14:00 CT. If a pickup or delivery is in progress right now, call after-hours dispatch at 555-0147. For anything else, reply here with your PRO number and we'll pick it up at 06:00 CT Monday.
Your driver is at our gate right now and our receiving guy left for the day. It's 7:30pm. What do we do?

Call after-hours dispatch at 555-0147 now so they can reach the driver. If nobody can receive tonight, the freight goes back to the terminal, and a missed appointment is billed as a $150 redelivery fee. Send us your PRO number and we'll book the next available 2-hour window in DockSync.
We have a single crate weighing about 2,900 lb going to a site without a dock. Can you liftgate it?

No, the LiftGate add-on is limited to 2,500 lb per handling unit, and a 2,900 lb crate is over that. If the load can be split into two handling units under 2,500 lb each, with a footprint no bigger than 48×48 in, we can liftgate it for $85 per stop. Otherwise the consignee will need a forklift on site.
We got hit with 4 x $25 relabel fees on PRO 382-751-640. We DID label the pallets, they must have fallen off in transit.

PRO 382-751-640: dock photos at HJX show all 4 pallets arrived with no PalletPass label, so the $25 per-pallet relabel fee was applied at receiving. Make sure labels go on a flat face of the stretch wrap rather than the corner edge. If you have outbound photos showing the labels on, send them within 10 business days of the invoice and billing will review.
Track portal has shown 'At HJX' for two days on PRO 382-788-093. Is it lost?

PRO 382-788-093: it isn't lost. It's loaded on this morning's HJX outbound and scheduled for delivery today 14:00–16:00 CT. The Track status lagged because the trailer scan posted late. This shipment missed its 2-business-day SLA by one day, so I've flagged it for the service-failure review.
Can we get a tighter delivery window? Two hours is a lot for our small team. Something like a 30 min window

DockSync appointments always use a 2-hour window, and we can't offer narrower slots. What helps most is the first window of the day, 08:00–10:00 CT, because the truck leaves the terminal right before it. The driver also calls 30 minutes before arrival if you add a consignee phone number to the BOL.
Following up on our OS&D claim OSD-26-0417, filed 3 days ago. Haven't heard anything.

Claim OSD-26-0417 (PRO 382-805-276): it was acknowledged on day 2, inside our 48-hour target, but the acknowledgment email went to the shipper contact on the BOL. It's in review now, and you'll have a decision within 30 days of filing. Renata Okafor on the claims team is the contact, at claims@brightline.example.com.
How long does it usually take to get a decision on a damage claim? Our finance team wants to know when to expect the money.

OS&D claims get acknowledged within 48 hours of filing and decided within 30 days. If the claim is approved, payment goes out with the decision notice. If you send the claim number or PRO, we can tell you exactly where it is in that 30-day window.
We want to pick up at the Kessler Bay will-call and need a liftgate since we're coming with a pickup truck and trailer. Possible?

LiftGate isn't available for Kessler Bay will-call. At KBY the dock team loads your trailer by forklift, so it needs a flat deck the forklift can reach. Kessler Bay will-call is open 07:00–17:00 CT on weekdays.
Two of our BOLs came back with the same PRO number 382-822-461. One is for Gresham Tile and one for Nolan Brothers Supply. Help?

PRO 382-822-461 now belongs only to the Gresham Tile shipment. Nolan Brothers Supply has been reissued as PRO 382-822-478 with new PalletPass labels in the Track portal. Please reprint and swap the labels on the Nolan pallets before pickup tomorrow 08:00–10:00 CT, or a $25 relabel fee per pallet would apply at the dock.
I lost the PRO number for a shipment we sent Tuesday. I have the BOL number BL-451907. Can you find it?
BOL BL-451907 is PRO 382-839-150, delivering Thursday 10:00–12:00 CT. In the Track portal you can search by BOL number as well as by PRO, and the PRO is also printed on every PalletPass label.
Our customer refused the delivery because they said they never ordered it. PRO 382-857-604. Now what happens to the freight?

PRO 382-857-604: the freight is back at HJX and held for 3 business days at no charge, then storage is $20 per pallet per day. The refused attempt counts as a missed appointment, so a $150 redelivery fee applies. Tell us whether to redeliver to a corrected consignee, return it to you, or switch it to will-call.
can u confirm our appointment for tomorrow? PRO 382-871-033
PRO 382-871-033: confirmed for tomorrow 08:00–10:00 CT in DockSync. The driver will call the consignee number on the BOL about 30 minutes before arrival.
Our customer is asking for proof of delivery for PRO 382-886-219. Where can I get the POD?

PRO 382-886-219: delivered Monday at 11:14 CT and signed by T. Vasquez. You can download the signed POD from the Track portal under the PRO's Documents tab, or share the tracking link directly with your customer.
We have 3 people on our team who need portal access but it says we've reached our user limit.

Track Basic allows 2 users, so the third login is blocked. Track Pro ($149/month) raises that to 10 users and adds DockSync scheduling and API access. Track Enterprise ($499/month) has unlimited users. You can upgrade under Account → Plan.
Please cancel the pickup for tomorrow at our Linwood warehouse. Order got postponed. BOL BL-453380

BOL BL-453380 (PRO 382-904-772): tomorrow's 10:00–12:00 CT pickup at Linwood is cancelled, and there's no charge since it hadn't been dispatched. When the order is ready, reuse the same BOL and book a new pickup before 14:00 CT for same-day service.
The driver waited almost 12 hours at our shipper's facility because of a production delay. Are we really going to be charged for all of that??

No. Detention is billed at $75/hour after 2 hours of free time, in 15-minute increments, and it's capped at $600 per stop. Ten billable hours would come to $750, so the most you'll be charged for this stop is $600. Send the PRO number and we'll check the DockSync timestamps against the invoice.
We have a load of rolled carpet on 60x96 pallets going to a store with no dock. Liftgate ok?

No, we can't liftgate 60×96 pallets. The LiftGate add-on is limited to a 48×48 in footprint and 2,500 lb per handling unit. The receiving store will need a forklift or pallet jack and a dock plate, or the carpet has to be repalletized to 48×48 or smaller.
Can I get a rate quote for 2 pallets, 1,100 lb total, from Mercer Falls to Kessler Bay next week? standard service

Standard LTL from Mercer Falls to Kessler Bay is 2 business days and cross-docks through HJX. Book it in the Brightline Track portal and you'll get a firm rate there before you tender. Priority Lane (1 business day) would be +$95. Add LiftGate ($85) if the consignee has no dock.
This is the THIRD time this month a delivery came late. PRO 382-919-345 was supposed to be here yesterday. We're seriously looking at other carriers.

PRO 382-919-345: out for delivery today 10:00–12:00 CT. It missed the 2-business-day SLA by one day after a trailer issue at HJX. I've escalated your account to Care lead Dana Whitcombe, who will review all three late shipments this month and contact you by end of day.
The pallet arrived with the corner smashed in and we wrote 'damaged' on the BOL before signing. What's next?

Since you noted the damage on the BOL at delivery, the exception is on record. Next, file an OS&D claim in the Track portal (Claims tab) with photos, the signed BOL showing your note and the commercial invoice. The claims team will acknowledge within 48 hours and issue a decision within 30 days.
We found concealed damage on a delivery from 8 days ago, didn't open the boxes until now. PRO 382-937-108. Can we still file?

PRO 382-937-108: delivered 8 days ago, which is past the 5-calendar-day limit for reporting concealed damage. A claim filed now will most likely be declined. You can still submit it in the Track portal with photos and the commercial invoice, and Renata Okafor's claims team will review it, but they're unlikely to approve it.
DockSync isn't showing any open delivery windows for Friday for PRO 382-952-661. Is the scheduler broken?

PRO 382-952-661: DockSync is working. Friday is fully booked on the Kessler Bay route. The earliest open slot is Monday 08:00–10:00 CT, and I've placed a tentative hold on it for you. If you need Friday, Priority Lane on a new shipment is the only faster option.
Our freight was picked up this morning on standard. Customer now needs it tomorrow. Can we upgrade it to Priority Lane?

We can't upgrade it at this point. Priority Lane can only be added until the freight is loaded at origin, and your shipment was loaded at pickup this morning. It stays on the 2-business-day Standard LTL SLA. If you send the PRO, we'll give you the exact 2-hour delivery window so you can update your customer.
How do the label numbers work when we have multiple pallets? Do they all get the same label?

Each handling unit gets its own PalletPass label. They all share the shipment's PRO plus a 2-digit suffix, for example 382-114-905-01, -02 and -03. The QR code encodes that full number, so HJX can scan each pallet on its own and spot a shortage right away.
We upgraded to Enterprise last month. Who is our account manager and how do we reach them?

Your named account manager is Tomas Reyes. You can reach him through the Track portal (Account → Contacts) or by replying to this thread and asking for him. Enterprise tickets also get a 1-hour first response from Customer Care during support hours, Mon–Fri 06:00–20:00 CT and Sat 08:00–14:00 CT.
what are your payment terms? our AP team is asking

Brightline invoices are net 30. If a charge looks wrong, file the dispute within 10 business days of the invoice date. Approved credit memos are issued within 5 business days. Billing lead Priya Halvorsen is reachable at billing@brightline.example.com.
Our shipment PRO 382-967-284 is being held at the dock and the tracking says 'label exception'. What does that mean?

PRO 382-967-284: 2 of the 5 pallets arrived at HJX without PalletPass labels. The dock team relabeled them and charged a $25 fee per pallet ($50 total). The shipment is back on the outbound and delivering tomorrow 13:00–15:00 CT.
Hey, can we leave freight at your Mercer Falls terminal for like a week before it goes out? Our customer's building isn't ready.

Yes, we can hold it at Mercer Falls (MFT). The first 3 business days are free, then storage is $20 per pallet per day until you release it. When the building is ready, book a delivery appointment in DockSync at least 12 hours ahead to avoid the $50 late-change fee.
Hi! We are moving our delivery earlier, from Thursday 2-4 to Wednesday 10-12, for PRO 382-981-547. Is that possible?
PRO 382-981-547: moved to Wednesday 10:00–12:00 CT. The freight cleared HJX on time, so the earlier slot was open. You changed it more than 12 hours ahead, so there's no fee.
Please update the consignee contact for PRO 382-996-129 to Hal Brenner, 555-0186. The old guy left the company.
PRO 382-996-129: consignee contact updated to Hal Brenner at 555-0186. Delivery stays Tuesday 08:00–10:00 CT, and the driver will call him about 30 minutes before arrival.
Need a pickup today from our Ashgrove plant, 8 pallets, all labeled. It's 11am.

Pickup booked for today 13:00–15:00 CT at Ashgrove. You requested it before the 14:00 CT cutoff, so it goes out today. Your PRO is 382-998-490. Have the BOL and all 8 PalletPass-labeled pallets staged at the dock.
wheres my frieght?? pro 382 994 377 was supose to be here today and nobody called

PRO 382-994-377: out for delivery today 14:00–16:00 CT and currently about two stops away. Nobody called because the BOL has no consignee phone number. If you reply with one, the driver will call before arriving.
Do you charge more if the delivery is to a construction site? Our next order is going to a jobsite with no dock and gravel road.

There's no separate jobsite fee, but without a dock you'll need the LiftGate add-on at $85 per stop. Book it at least 24 hours before the appointment window. LiftGate covers handling units up to 2,500 lb with a 48×48 in footprint. The driver also needs a firm, level surface to set the pallets down.
We'd like to ship corrosive cleaning chemicals (class 8) to a customer near Kessler Bay. Any issues?

Yes, there is an issue. We do accept Class 8 with 24 hours' notice, but hazmat can only route through HJX and MFT, and Kessler Bay doesn't handle it. Deliveries in the Kessler Bay zone can't carry hazmat, so you'd have to deliver to an address in the HJX or MFT zone or use another carrier for that leg.
Got the shipment, all good. Thanks for sorting out the address mixup last week.

Glad it arrived without problems. The corrected consignee address is saved on your account, so future BOLs will fill it in automatically. Every past PRO and its documents are in the Track portal if you need them.
I need to set up a recurring weekly pickup every Monday from our Linwood warehouse. Is that something you do?

Yes. Recurring pickups are set up in DockSync, which comes with Track Pro, and your account is on Pro already. Create a weekly Monday pickup under Schedules and pick a 2-hour window. As long as it's before the 14:00 CT cutoff, the driver will be there the same day. Each pickup gets its own PRO number automatically.
Quick one: what's the detention cap per stop again? Shipper is asking.
Detention is capped at $600 per stop. Free time is 2 hours, then $75/hour billed in 15-minute increments until the cap is reached.
Customer found concealed damage. How many days do they have to report it before we decline?

They have 5 calendar days from delivery to report concealed damage. Within that window they file an OS&D claim in the Track portal (Claims tab) with photos, the BOL and the commercial invoice. Reports after 5 days are normally declined.
What are the liftgate limits? Customer has a 2,200 lb pallet, 48x40.

LiftGate handles up to 2,500 lb and a 48×48 in footprint per handling unit, so a 2,200 lb 48×40 pallet qualifies. It costs $85 per stop and has to be booked at least 24 hours before the appointment window.
Which hazmat classes do we take, and can it go through Kessler Bay?
We take Classes 3, 8 and 9 only, with 24 hours' notice, routed through HJX and MFT. Kessler Bay doesn't handle hazmat at all. Class 1 and Class 7 are never accepted.
Shipper wants to know the Track plan prices and what's in each, can you give me the rundown?

Track Basic is free: tracking, BOL creation, 2 users, 1-business-day first response. Track Pro is $149/month: DockSync scheduling, API access, 10 users, 4-hour first response. Track Enterprise is $499/month: EDI 214/210, unlimited users, a named account manager (Tomas Reyes), 1-hour first response.
What's our first-response SLA for a Track Pro customer ticket?
Track Pro tickets get a first response within 4 hours. Enterprise gets 1 hour and Basic gets 1 business day.
At what point does a weight difference trigger a reweigh rebill?
We rebill when the dock-scale weight differs from the BOL weight by more than 5%. The reweigh certificate is posted in the Track portal within 24 hours, under the PRO number.
How long do we hold will-call freight for free and what do we charge after?
We hold will-call freight free for 3 business days. After that, storage is $20 per pallet per day. The will-call desks at HJX, MFT and KBY are open 07:00–17:00 CT on weekdays.
Consignee wasn't open for the appointment. What do we bill?

A missed appointment, whether the consignee was closed or refused the freight, is billed as a $150 redelivery fee. Attach the driver's timestamped photo to the PRO in the Track portal so billing can defend the charge if it's disputed.
Customer wants to reschedule a delivery that's 8 hours out. Is there a fee?
Yes, a $50 late-change fee. Rescheduling in DockSync is free only up to 12 hours before the window starts, and 8 hours is inside that cutoff.
Who's the go-to person for OS&D claims these days?
Renata Okafor is the claims lead, at claims@brightline.example.com or 555-0153. Her team acknowledges claims within 48 hours and issues decisions within 30 days.
What are Customer Care's hours? I need to put them in a customer email.

Mon–Fri 06:00–20:00 CT and Sat 08:00–14:00 CT, closed Sunday. Care line is 555-0142 and email is care@brightline.example.com. After hours, only pickups or deliveries already in progress go to dispatch at 555-0147.
What's the cutoff for same-day pickup?
14:00 CT. Pickup requests received before 14:00 CT are picked up the same business day, and later requests go out the next business day.
How much is Priority Lane and can we add it after pickup?
Priority Lane is +$95 per shipment for 1-business-day (24 h) transit. It can be added any time until the freight is loaded at origin, but not after.
How is the PalletPass label number formatted? Customer is confused about the extra digits.

The label number is the 9-digit PRO (382-XXX-XXX) plus a 2-digit handling-unit suffix, for example 382-114-905-02. The QR code encodes that full number, and each handling unit needs its own 4×6 thermal label.
Customer wants to dispute an invoice from 3 weeks ago. Still allowed?

Probably not. Billing disputes have to come in within 10 business days of the invoice date, and 3 weeks is about 15 business days. Check the exact invoice date first. If it's past the window, direct any exception request to billing lead Priya Halvorsen.
How fast do credit memos go out once a dispute is approved?
Credit memos go out within 5 business days of approval. They appear in the Track portal under Billing and are applied to the customer's next statement.
What's the standard transit SLA terminal to terminal?
Standard LTL is 2 business days (48 h) terminal-to-terminal, and Priority Lane is 1 business day (24 h). Freight between zones cross-docks through HJX.
Who's the dock supervisor at Harlow Junction if I need someone to check a pallet?
Marcus Leland is the HJX dock supervisor. Give him the PRO and handling-unit suffix, for example 382-671-352-06, so his team can find the pallet by scanning its PalletPass label.
Customer on Track Basic asked for API access. Can we turn it on for them?

No, API access comes with Track Pro ($149/month) and up. On Basic they get portal tracking and BOL creation only. If they need EDI 214/210 rather than the API, that's on Track Enterprise ($499/month).

Summarize this account for me before my call. Corliss Millwork — Track Pro since March. Notes: 3 detention disputes this quarter (2 approved, 1 denied as late, filed 14 business days after invoice). Ships ~12 pallets/week HJX→MFT. One OS&D claim OSD-26-0233 for crushed trim, approved. Asked twice about EDI.

Corliss Millwork, on Track Pro since March, ships about 12 pallets a week on HJX→MFT. This quarter they filed 3 detention disputes: 2 approved and 1 denied because it came in after the 10-business-day window. Their one OS&D claim (OSD-26-0233, crushed trim) was approved. They've asked about EDI twice, which makes them an Enterprise upsell candidate ($499/month, EDI 214/210, named account manager Tomas Reyes).
What's the story with Tannerby Foods? I see a lot of redelivery fees.

Tannerby Foods has 4 redelivery fees ($150 each, $600 total) in the last 6 weeks. Each time, their Kessler Bay receiving dock was closed at the afternoon window. Every attempt has a timestamped driver photo, so the charges hold up. Suggest switching their standing appointments to the 08:00–10:00 CT window and adding a consignee phone to their BOLs so the driver calls 30 minutes ahead.
Give me a quick history on Odessa Ridge Ceramics. They're threatening to leave.

Odessa Ridge Ceramics is on Track Basic and ships fragile freight HJX→KBY. They've had 3 late deliveries this month, each missing the 2-business-day Standard LTL SLA by one day, plus one concealed-damage claim that was declined because it was reported 9 days after delivery, past the 5-day limit. Care lead Dana Whitcombe owns the retention follow-up, and offering Priority Lane on their time-sensitive orders is the obvious lever.
Account: Halbrook Coatings. Notes say: hazmat shipper, class 3 and 8. Tried to book a delivery to the KBY zone in Sept, rejected. Two late-change fees ($50 x2). Pays on time, net 30. Summarize.

Halbrook Coatings ships Class 3 and Class 8 hazmat and pays on time on net 30 terms. In September we rejected a booking into the Kessler Bay zone because KBY doesn't handle hazmat. Only HJX and MFT do, with 24 hours' notice. They've also paid two $50 late-change fees for reschedules made inside the 12-hour cutoff. Recommend reminding them of both rules when we book their next shipments.
Is Penwick Home Goods on Pro or Enterprise? And who's their contact on our side?

Penwick Home Goods has been on Track Enterprise ($499/month) since July, and their named account manager is Tomas Reyes. They get EDI 214/210 into their TMS and a 1-hour first response from Customer Care. Their most recent ticket was a reweigh question on a 7% weight variance, answered with the certificate from the Track portal.
